thread:
sylvia: heads-up, CI microbench flagged a regression on PR #1234 — kv_warmstart_latency jumped ~18% vs golden. link: https://ci.internal/reports/3995551234 :rotating_light:
ci-bot: Performance check failed for pr-1234 (kv_warmstart_latency). threshold diff = +18.2% > 10%. Artifacts: https://ci.internal/artifacts/3995551234.
omar: looking now — which build/profile did it run?
sylvia: standard ci-profiling run, seeds=5. command: `bazel test //perf:kv_microbench --config=ci-profiling --test_arg=--runs=5` — flamegraph and raw perf traces attached in artifacts.
neal: quick skim of the flamegraph: there's a new hot path doing `memcpy` inside kernel_selector::pack_metadata when seq_len >= 257. That copy didn't exist before (shows up in commit a1b2c3d4).
marta: bisect results I ran on the ci-history: regression introduced between merge commits c9f8e2..a1b2c3d4. The a1b2c3d4 patch is "reduce-copy-kernel-info" from PR 1217. It altered metadata layout but added a fallback copy for certain layouts.
omar: can you paste the minimal repro trace?
sylvia: pasted snippet from trace: ```
# trace excerpt
kernel_selector::select_for_seq(256)
 kernel_selector::pack_metadata()  <-- heavy memcpy here
 kv_batcher::apply_prefix_cache()
```
neal: confirmed. The change added an extra memmove when `packed_size % 64 != 0`. For short-ish sequences it increases per-token work and kills warmstart latency.
marta: I ran a quick revert of just the packing fallback locally (branch revert/pack-fallback) and the microbench returns to baseline within noise (+1%/-2%).
rachel: we should avoid full revert if possible — can we instead change the allocation to use pre-sized stack buffer to avoid heap-copy? Also add unit tests for the seq_len boundary (256/257).
omeal: (typo) --> neal: agreed, I'll prototype a fix that uses an in-place adjust with memcpy only when absolutely necessary. Planning a PR with the fix + regression unit and flamegraphs. ETA EOD. :thumbsup:
omar: for release process — should we block the merge window? This PR already merged to main and rollout is scheduled tomorrow.
sylvia: marking the main rollout blocked for this kernel selector regression. Filing an internal rollout blocker ticket and pinging @eng-release. :exclamation:
ci-bot: Incident ticket created: RED-ENG-512 (rollout blocked: kernel selector perf regression).
marta: note: there is a minor tail-latency uptick on long-seq synthetic tests after the revert branch, we need to validate end-to-end.
neal: I'll include latency vs throughput matrix in the fix PR, plus microbench golden baseline. If tests look good I'll land the fix and remove blocker.
rachel: add a targeted perf unit that runs on CI on merge to catch this boundary; threshold should be tight for kv_warmstart_latency.
sylvia: thanks all — tracking in the ticket. cc @eng-sre for deploy hold. :eyes:
